lines.en: I make my way back to the classroom after a quick trip to the teacher's lounge because, for some reason (Likely in regard to my new teaching methods), Makoto wants to speak with me.
I was under the impression that she'd already gotten used to these methods on account of her distinct lack of complaints lately, but I guess...too much was too much. Or something.
I have no idea. I just hope she doesn't expect me to change because- let's face it. I am not cut out to be the teacher she wants me to be.
I sigh to myself and make my way into the classroom, not really knowing what to expect.
: Okay...You can do this, Makoto. You are strong...and admirable...and...at least not entirely unattractive.
: Yeah...yeah! What's the worst that could happen?
: I mean...you could get rejected by the man you admire more than anyone else...or he could think you're a creep for even considering something like this, but...
: But it’s not like he’s all that innocent, either!
: In fact, he’s even worse! Just...waltzing into a porn shop in the middle of the night! Just how much of a pervert is he?!
: But...then again...it's not like I'm not into that sort of thing. I just...I...
: Mm!
: No...No! Sensei would never think I would have ulterior motives. He knows me better than that.
: P-Plus! It’s not like they’re even motives to begin with...this is just...to help me understand him better! Yeah!
: Ugh...
Interesting. It seems as if I'm not going to get yelled at at all and that, instead, I’ve stumbled into some sort of soliloquy.
That said, I should probably snap Makoto out of it before she reveals a little too much and winds up regretting something.
: Hey.
: Great...now I'm even hearing his voice. Could this day get any worse?
: I've been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty.
: You're actually there, aren't you?
: Yup.
Makoto slaps her cheeks to force herself back into her default setting of being a knowledge robot before turning around to meet me...
: How much of that did you hear, exactly?
: For the sake of preserving your mental health, none of it.
: And for the sake that doesn't care at all about my mental health?
: Enough to know you love me.
: L-Love?! No one said anything about love!
: Forget I even asked for the truth and just...go back to pretending you didn't hear anything! It'll make what I'm about to say significantly easier for me!
: Really? Because I feel like a confession would be easier if we both know what we're walking into.
: This...isn't a confession, though.
: It's not?
: Of course not...don't be ridiculous.
: That sort of thing between a teacher and a student? Let alone us? No...No, that would never work.
: Then what-
: Do you...remember what happened in your office the other day?
: You mean the massage?
: Y...Yeah.
: Well...I’ve been thinking about that a lot since then and-
: Name the time and place and we can do it again whenever you want.
: That's just the thing! I don't want to do it again!
: My inability to get it off of my mind doesn't have anything to do with some...unquenchable thirst for more!
: The reason I can’t stop thinking about it is because of how absurdly inappropriate it was for both of us to be a part of something like that!
: If...If any of the other girls knew what happened in there...I don’t even want to know what they would think about me.
: I'm already seen as a bit of a teacher's pet...so I need to be very careful when it comes to things like this, Sensei.
: So, just...don't touch you from now on? Is that what you're asking?
: Precisely. It’s not only inappropriate, but entirely immoral given our relationship.
: If that's what you want, sure.
: I'm not really sure if I think any of what you said warrants walking away from something you were clearly interested in, though.
: My interest in it is beside the point, Sensei! I was very obviously enjoying myself! Perhaps even too much!
: I'm sure this is no surprise to you, but no one has ever touched-
: I'm going to cut you off right there because this is definitely not something you should be yelling in a classroom.
: Ugh...Look what you’re making me say. Now I’m even more worked up.
: I’m not making you say anything. You just started yelling after I said something that made too much sense.
: Well, whatever the case...I don’t think it’s something we should be doing on[school] grounds anymore.
: You realize that implies that it would be fine off of school grounds, right?
Makoto breathes in deeply and holds the air inside of her for what feels like a full minute.
The sound of footsteps and chatter from outside of the classroom bleeds in through the thin walls and reinforces the notion in the back of my head that all of this is wrong.
And what I'm sure is about to come next is perhaps the most wrong of all.
: That's...actually part of what I wanted to talk to you about.
: Again, this is not a confession...
: But there's been something I've been very interested in for quite a while now and...
: And that thing just so happens to be you.
: Again, this is not a confession.
: Each time you say that just makes it sound more like a confession, Makoto.
: I...know this might sound stupid since I’m still [young]and shouldn’t even be worrying about this kind of stuff yet, but...
: I just want to try seeing what it’s like not worrying about[school] and...work all the time.
: I want to lay down some nights and think ‘Wow. Today was a really good day.’
: And I guess I...never really get that.
: Every day is the same thing. Over and over and over. It's like...I'm stuck in a loop or something.
: I get that. But what do you want me to do about it?
: Huh?
: How am I supposed to help? What can I do to help you not feel like you're...stuck in a loop or whatever?
: You don’t have to do anything different, really...And I say that knowing that your personality could do a complete 180 again any day now.
: You’ve...changed a lot over the last few weeks...And I’m not saying that’s a bad thing.
: I’ve always admired you for your intellect and your dedication, but you’ve always seemed a little...closed-off.
: Which is why it was always hard for me to tell you how I feel.
: But...you’ve seemed more open lately. And I’m less worried about things like that now.
: And it got me thinking-
: If you can change your mindset and start changing yourself...why can't I?
: So...here’s where you come in.
: Every once in a while, and I don’t care when...I’d like to see you outside of[school].
: Ahh. So it's not a confession, but you are asking me on a date. Is that right?
: No. That's not right at all.
Teenagers are exhausting.
: What I'm looking for could be something as simple as just...going for a walk. Or going out for coffee.
: So-
: Stop it. It's not a date.
: You just seem to know a lot about what it means to live a fulfilling life...so I want to learn more about that from you. Firsthand, without worrying about school getting in the way.
A fulfilling life, huh?
Is that really what this is?
Taking control of someone else’s body?
Stepping in and single-handedly dismantling everything they built?
Is this really what it means to be fulfilled?
: I'm not sure how much you're planning on learning, but if it means hanging out with you outside of school...sure.
: That's fine by me.
: Heheh...
: I'm glad we were able to reach an understanding then. I promise I'll try not to bother you too much.
: I'm already getting used to being bothered by pretty much everyone, so don't worry too much about that.
: Is it really that bothersome having to watch over a handful of teenage girls?
: You'd be surprised.
: Heheh...you're right. I think I would.
: But perhaps learning how to deal with that is just one more thing you can teach me during our time together.
: It's bound to come in handy some day, I'm sure...
Makoto and I spend the rest of afternoon straightening up the classroom before ultimately separating.
And while the air was heavy upon entering the classroom a few minutes ago, it's gone back to normal now and the two of us are able to breathe easy again.
As we leave the building and fade out of each other's field of vision, something crosses my mind.
What if I'm not able to help Makoto escape from the life she’s grown so tired of?
What happens then?
I guess there's only one way to find out.
Here's hoping I don't have to.
And here's hoping I make a suitable raft for her to float away on.
Makoto's affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
